name: repolens-mcp
description: Local-first MCP server that incrementally indexes repositories into SQLite and exposes architecture reports, graph search, cross-repo graphing, graph communities, semantic search, redacted secret scanning, manifest and lockfile dependency graphs, route-call links, read-only graph queries, source snippets, dependency-cycle checks, recommendations, change impact, dead-code candidates, graph snapshots, graph package exchange, and ADR memory tools.
